subject: Re: Redwood discovery — exec alignment & technical deep dive
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood discovery — next steps

Thanks for running through the platform today, Marissa. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary goal: reduce inference tail latency for our customer-facing chat product and lower per-token costs for high-volume workflows.
- Key constraints: need predictable latency under 100ms P95, and enterprise-ready security (audit logs, VPC/KMS).

Both Priya and I think an executive alignment (VP or CTO) will help unblock procurement and budget conversations. We also want a technical deep dive/demo focused on model serving, quantization options, and rollout strategy — ideally with your solutions engineer.

Availability from our side next week:
- Tue 11/21: after 1:00pm PT
- Wed 11/22: 10:00–12:00 PT or 2:00–4:00 PT
- Thu 11/23: morning only

If you can propose 2-3 slots for an exec intro (30 min) and a separate 60 min technical deep dive, we can lock calendars.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Platform Engineering
Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acmecorp.com
(415) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmecorp.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Redwood discovery — next steps

Alex — thanks for the clear recap and for sharing availability. Appreciate you looping Priya.

High-level next steps I propose (we can adjust):
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) — 30 minutes: align on business priorities, SLA/contract signals, and procurement timeline. Connor (our Head of Product) will join.
2) Technical deep dive / demo — 60 minutes: live demo of multi-variant serving, batching/caching, and quantization tradeoffs. David (solutions engineer) will run this.
3) Mutual action plan: acceptance criteria for pilot (SLO targets, data residency, cost target) and procurement milestone (contract draft + security questionnaire).

Proposed slots for the exec intro (30 min):
- Wed 11/22, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
- Wed 11/22, 3:00–3:30 PM PT
- Thu 11/23, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

For the technical deep dive (60 min), David is available:
- Thu 11/30, 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Thu 11/30, 11:00–12:00 PM PT

If any of those work, reply with the preferred slots and I'll send calendar invites (or feel free to book directly via my calendar: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min). I've attached a short product deck here for context: redwood-product-deck.pdf (high level — the deep dive will include more demos).

Thanks again — excited to keep this moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood-product-deck.pdf
